billing.dunning: We could not charge your subscription{attempt, plural, =0 {} other { (attempt # of 3)}}. Please check your card — after the third failure, generation stops.

billing.grace: Your paid period ended{until, select, none {} other { on {until}}}. You are running on a few days of grace while the renewal completes.
billing.expiring_soon: Your subscription renews{until, select, none { in a few days} other { on {until}}}.
billing.cancelled: You cancelled your subscription — it still runs until{until, select, none { the end of the period} other { {until}}}. You can renew it any time before then.
billing.gift_ending: Your free plan ends{until, select, none { in a few days} other { on {until}}}. Nothing will be charged — pick a plan if you want to continue.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.text: We always use the technically necessary cookies for signing in — the service would not work without them. Beyond those we would like to measure traffic with Google Analytics to learn what to fix on the site. That runs only with your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
